notes.title: Exit the Abyss – Update 3.0 is Live!
notes.notes: [p]Update 3.0 for [i]Exit the Abyss[/i] is now available! This new version brings several improvements and refinements to enhance the tense and oppressive atmosphere of the game. Thank you to everyone who has supported the project and shared feedback — we couldn’t have made it this far without you![/p]

notes.title: 🎉 Exit the Abyss 2.0 is here!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm excited to announce that Exit the Abyss version 2.0 is now live! This marks a huge milestone for me — my very first game is now complete.

🛠️ What's new in 2.0?
A number of bug fixes for a smoother experience

General performance optimizations for better stability and smoother gameplay

Brand new levels to explore

And most importantly: the story is now complete — you can now experience the full journey from beginning to end

💬 Thank you
A heartfelt thank you to everyone who supported this project by purchasing the game. Your patience, feedback, and encouragement have meant the world to me. Every message, comment, and review helped shape this project into what it is today.

🔚 What’s next?
With this update, Exit the Abyss is officially complete. I'm now shifting my focus to a brand new project — and I can’t wait to share more about it in the future.

💸 50% off sale coming soon!
To celebrate the release of version 2.0, the game will go on 50% off sale at the end of the month, lasting for two full weeks. If you haven’t picked it up yet, this will be the perfect time!

Thank you again for being part of this journey! 🙏

notes.title: Exit the Abyss – The 1.5 Update is Canceled, 2.0 is Coming!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

On March 24, I announced the 1.5 update, but during development, I realized that the game needed more than just a small update. So, the 1.5 update has been canceled, and instead, a bigger, more complete 2.0 update is coming in April – and with it, the game will finally be fully finished.

What’s changing?

The remaining levels will be added, completing the full game experience.

Based on your feedback, I’ve redesigned the levels – Exit the Abyss will no longer be just a walking simulator. You can now run anywhere!

Major visual improvements make the game look much more realistic and immersive.

Thank you for your patience and support! Exit the Abyss 2.0 launches in April, marking the completion of the game. Stay tuned so you don’t miss it! 🔥

notes.title: New Jump Scares, Performance Improvements, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that the latest update for Exit the Abyss is now live! This version brings several exciting changes:

New Jump Scares: The atmosphere just got even more intense! The new terrifying elements add even more tension and surprises, drawing you deeper into the horror experience.

Performance Improvements: The game now runs even smoother! We've optimized the performance to ensure a seamless experience on all devices.

Bug Fixes: We've addressed several minor bugs to make your experience even more enjoyable. Stability and a bug-free experience are now top priorities.

Thank you for your continued support, and don't forget to share your feedback!

Join us in the world of anxiety and fear, and try to escape the depths of the Abyss!

notes.title: Thank You! What’s Next?
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

First of all, a huge thank you to every player who has tried Exit the Abyss! Your feedback means the world to me, and seeing the game reach its audience is an incredible feeling.

Now that the game is out, I want to take this experience even further. I’m working on some bigger updates, and I’d love to hear your thoughts:

🔴 Which part scared you the most?
💡 What extra challenges or new modes would you like to see?

One thing is certain: this is just the beginning! If you haven’t already, consider leaving a review – it really helps others discover the game.

Thank you for being here, and stay tuned because more updates are coming soon! 👀

notes.title: The darkness hasn’t let go yet... To be continued."
notes.notes:
The first chapter of Exit the Abyss is here! You can now experience the eerie, nightmarish hospital filled with 6 rooms of unsettling puzzles, psychological horror, and ever-growing tension. But this is just the beginning...

The story doesn’t end here! Development continues, and deeper layers of the hospital hold even more terrifying challenges. Stay with us and prepare for what’s next!
